item.text: {"case":"getgoal-duo1-2013","answers":[{"question_id":"sq:missing:data-available","answer":"no_information","rationale":"The randomized comparison included 223 participants per arm, but the HbA1c analysis denominator was 221 for placebo and 215 for lixisenatide. These are analyzed counts, not confirmed observed-outcome counts: the report says LOCF was used and defines the analysis population by baseline and post-baseline efficacy assessments, but does not state how many had week-24 HbA1c actually observed. Completion counts (211 and 194) and discontinuations do not establish whether outcomes were collected after treatment ended.
